title: Gift of Crystallized Blood

fields.label: Function
fields.value: When opened, it becomes a decorative trophy.

body:
"A Very sturdy box that feels very old and magical..."

The Gift of Crystalized Blood was available for purchase at the The Monstrous Manor for $44,400 during the 2024 Halloween Event.

Details

The Gift of Crystalized Blood can now be opened as of 11/04/2024.

This gift was introduced along with the Gift Of Spectral Whispers. Both were sold at the The Monstrous Manor.
